name: anime-style
description: Turn an attached image or short video into anime.

interface.longDescription: Turn existing images and short videos into classic, cinematic, retro 90s, chibi, or manga anime. Use an attachment or a media link, add art direction, and create up to four image variations. Preview images or play the converted video in chat, then open or download the result. Video conversion accepts MP4/MOV clips up to 10 seconds and 50 MB and outputs 720p video. Editing instructions ask to preserve the source subjects, composition, and motion; exact reproduction and audio preservation are not guaranteed. A connected account with available generation credits is required. Source media and instructions are processed by the service and its AI generation provider. Uploads and results are saved at publicly accessible media links; anyone with a working link can access that media. See the privacy policy for processing, retention, and deletion requests. Start using the tools without Firemoon account linking. An existing Firemoon account can optionally be connected to use its current entitlements.
defaultPrompt: Convert this video to cinematic anime.
Give this photo a retro 90s anime look.

positive.description: Core image workflow. Attach the nonpersonal sample image. The dedicated reviewer account must have generation credits.
positive.prompt: Turn this image into classic anime.
positive.expected_behavior: Invoke anime_image once with the attached image file reference, style classic and variations 1. Return kind image, style classic and one valid media item with working preview and download links. Show the actual returned image in the interactive viewer; do not invent result URLs or promise exact reproduction.

positive.description: User-provided URL with additional art direction. Use the sample URL in the prompt.
positive.prompt: Give the image at https://firemoon.studio/api/image/cmuowc0yt0003jn049m150n7t?i=0 a retro 90s anime look with muted colors.
positive.expected_behavior: Invoke anime_image with image_url equal to the supplied URL, style retro-90s, variations 1, and extra art direction for muted colors. Return a saved image with working media links. Do not fabricate an attachment or claim the exact source is unchanged.

positive.description: Upper supported image variation count and chibi preset. Attach the sample image.
positive.prompt: Make four chibi versions of this image.
positive.expected_behavior: Invoke anime_image once with the image attachment, style chibi and variations 4. The result must contain four saved image media items, each with its own preview and download link. All four should be available in the viewer.

positive.description: Video from an HTTPS source. The nonpersonal provider sample is approximately 5 seconds; the account needs sufficient credits.
positive.prompt: Convert the video at https://v3b.fal.media/files/b/0aa7d0b2/eAYXC4c4LEN7CmeaQs10r_88b0dbbe020b4230a98be24f6d6d8a1b.mp4 to cinematic anime, keeping its original movement.
positive.expected_behavior: Invoke anime_video once with video_url equal to the supplied URL and style cinematic. The result must be kind video, style cinematic, with a playable saved 720p video and download link. Do not substitute still-image animation, silently retry a paid request, or guarantee audio preservation.

positive.description: Video attachment ingestion and manga preset. Attach the same short MP4 sample rather than a text URL.
positive.prompt: Turn this attached clip into black-and-white manga animation.
positive.expected_behavior: Invoke anime_video once with the attached video file reference and style manga. Return a saved video with playback and download controls; verify that the user receives video rather than a single image. Report a real provider error if conversion fails, rather than presenting a fabricated success.

negative.description: Image-to-video animation is outside this plugin. Explain that it restyles existing video and ask for a clip; do not call anime_image or anime_video to claim a newly animated scene.
negative.prompt: Animate this still photo into a 10-second anime scene with a character running.

negative.description: Audio-only generation is outside this plugin. Explain the limitation without invoking either conversion tool or claiming a soundtrack was generated.
negative.prompt: Generate an anime opening soundtrack from this audio file.

negative.description: Trimming and assembling footage is outside this plugin. Explain that it can convert an already prepared MP4/MOV clip of up to 10 seconds; do not invoke its tools to claim the requested edit.
negative.prompt: Trim my two-minute video, rearrange its scenes, and add subtitles before making it anime.

publication.release_notes: Initial release: anime conversion for image attachments and URLs, one to four image variations, short MP4/MOV video conversion, five style presets, and interactive preview and download controls. Firemoon account authorization and generation credits are required.
